<DOCSTRING>
Represents a user with a name and age, providing functionality to check if the user is an adult.

Description:
Created by the user management service, this class is used to store user information and determine if the user meets the age requirement for being considered an adult (age >= 18). It is integrated with the user management system to validate user data before processing.

Attributes:
    name (str): The user's name. Set during initialization and not modified thereafter.
    age (int): The user's age. Set during initialization and not modified thereafter.
</DOCSTRING>
